evidence:
Authority: inspected the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 14 (number 13) says 'Any shipped inputs exist at the expected path and their content matches what the prompt, solution, and judges assume'; Internal Quality Checks row 14 has the same interpretation and no additional annotation. Also inspected Deterministic Checks rows 4, 9 and 12 for asset references, actual COPY sources, and fixture parsing. Applied frozen harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md and references/quality-checks.md:58-60, staged-task-contract.md:14,175, and deterministic-checks.md's Dockerfile/source-check procedure. This is a manual/source review, not a private checker or hosted run.

Frozen-byte binding: independently recomputed SHA256 for all 50 task files and all 34 frozen rule files listed in qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/manifest.json; zero mismatches. Manifest input_sha256 equals the assigned hash.

Paths and copying: frozen task/instruction.md:5 names 'the six notes in /instructions' and '/assets/seed_data.json'; line 9 names /instructions/integration.md. The directory contains exactly behaviour.md, integration.md, overview.md, policy.md, security.md and ui.md. Recursively checked every /assets/... or /instructions/... reference in the brief and all six notes, including behaviour.md and security.md cross-references: every target exists. environment/Dockerfile:14-16 says 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. Both COPY source directories exist. environment/assets has exactly seed_data.json, which parses successfully.

Content agreement: environment/assets/seed_data.json:2-4 identifies 'Colderwater Playground', has 'snippets': [], and says 'No implementation or starter files are supplied; the app provides its own runnable examples.' This matches instruction.md:5, environment/instructions/overview.md:9 and integration.md:9. integration.md:9 explicitly says the delivered runtime cannot depend on /assets or /instructions remaining available. The reference creates an empty snippets table without seeding records (solution/app/server.js:113-128), supplies its examples under its own app directory (src/app.tsx:7,53-60; server.js:100), and solve.sh:26 copies that directory to /app. All five referenced example files exist and were inspected; hello.js:2's '#out' target is supplied by src/runtime.ts:3. The intentionally broken/infinite examples are labelled as such in starters/README.md and their source; they are not missing supplied inputs.

Inspected all five judge configurations, all five judge prompts and app_context.md for input/fixture assumptions; all five configurations parse. tests/app_context.md:8 agrees that no participant starter implementation or saved snippets are supplied. Its line 24 preserves the continuing database. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:119 accepts either an example or a previously loaded snippet, and :121 explicitly says 'no particular example names, source language, picker layout or save-dialog design are required.' No judge text depends on any of the reference's five example filenames. Constraints judge.toml:25-29 creates and independently retrieves its own record; it explicitly rejects a static seed response as proof.

Additional reference-asset check: public/index.html:1-2 names two built assets; both files exist beneath public/assets. src/runtime.ts:253 references /runner.html, present in public; public/runner.html and static/runner.html have identical bytes. server.js:100-102 serves the corresponding app directories. These URL assets are under /app/public/assets and are distinct from the participant input directory /assets.

Counterexample attempts: a conforming implementation using differently named, independently authored examples and an initially empty library is expressly accepted by S01 and the shared context, so the empty seed does not falsely fail it. A broken implementation returning only the static seed or a hardcoded example cannot establish the authored run plus clean-context save/read demanded by the gates. In-memory sensitivity checks removed the asset COPY directive and removed the seed from the path inventory; both missing-input cases were detected. No source files were mutated. No credible row-13 false-pass or false-fail witness remains.

Limits: observations above are frozen-file inspection, SHA256 comparison, JSON/TOML parsing and read-only in-memory checks. No Docker, network, paid provider, full configured judge, Oracle or target-model run was performed or claimed. Those runtime measurements are separate from this asset-consistency row.
